posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Devra couldn’t take her eyes off the news coverage.

All those people, all that destruction, it was too much.

The others were right, they couldn’t have stopped it, they were no match for that fleet.

She understood why they were heading for the portal, wherever it was.  She understood the prison rescue, she had always understood why the Scholar had left her to be captured in Egypt.

That didn’t make her feel any better about it.

The only hope anyone had now was fixing this in the past.  This world, her world, was dying.  Ra’s staff, The Rod Harry carried, and the Scholar’s stone.  They were all needed for the portal to work, Nightmist, The Visionary, even Harry had risked their lives and hers to free Ra.  They had one shot, go back in time, save this Legacy guy’s father and stop some madman named Baron Blade from creating this hellish reality.

She thought of Amanda and her mother, maybe they could both be saved, maybe when this was fixed Amanda would have a mother who loved her.  Unity could fight for that.

*Loud noises*

Suddenly the Bus wretched into the air, and an explosion rocked the air around them.

"Leave Legacy, get Ra!" Wraith yelled through the smoke and fire. They had to keep Ra safe, no matter what.

Haka pulled the doctor free of the wreckage, then looked to see a helicopter landing roughly twenty feet from the bus.

"Hello Friends," a voice came over a megaphone, "I am pleased to announce you will all soon be dead."

Episode 5:

Number of Heroes: 3-5

Available Heroes: Haka, Mr. Fixer (with rod), Nightmist, Tachyon, Visionary, Unity, Wraith, Scholar.

Villain: Ambuscade special edition

Environment: Rook City

Special Rules:

1. When a trap is shuffled into the dack by its text play the top card of the villain deck.

2. Ambuscade has a dog, his name is Fido. Information to follow below:

3. Ra is a hero target with 10hp, text on the card reads:

"Place this card next to a hero target, when Ra would take damage that hero may take the damage instead."

"At the Start of a hero turn, a hero may take Ra and put him next to their hero card."

"If Ra reaches 0hp the heroes lose the game."

 

Ambuscade's Dog, front side.

FIDO, Gene-Bound Doberman.  (H)x4hp

This card is indestructible.

When Fido reaches 0 or fewer HP, return this card to the villain play area and flip this card.

The first time each round Ambuscade targets a Hero Character Card for damage, or damages a Hero Character Card place Fido next to that hero, that hero may discard/destroy up to (H)-1 cards, If (H)-1 cards are not destroyed/discarded this way that hero cannot play cards, use powers or deal damage until the start of the next villain turn. 

At the start of the turn if this card is in the villain play area play the top card of the villain deck.

At the start of the villain turn return this card to the villain play area.

Second side.

FIDO, licking his wounds.

This card is indestructible.

At the end of the environment turn shuffle the villain trash and reveal cards until a device or trap is found, put that card into play or under this card.

Personal Cloaking Device cannot be put under this card.

If there are three or more cards under this card, put those cards in the villain trash and flip this card, restoring it to full HP.

Sorting out some rules and such with Fido:

The effect on the first side goes off even if you don't take the damage, it goes off before redirection takes place, or if the target is immune.  If Ambuscade cannot deal damage it will not trigger, which will cause the start of turn effect to take place at the start of the next round.  If Ambuscade targets a non-character card it does not trigger, but if that damage is redirected to a hero character card it will trigger on that hero.  If Ambuscade damages a non-character card hero target, then targets a hero character card it will trigger on the character card.

The hero who is targetted gets until the start of their turn to decide, they can post their decision and action(s) at that point.  They can't draw a card on someone else's turn and then discard it to fulfil requirements, but if they do met the requirement they could then draw cards they would have drawn on other player's turn.

On the second side:  I will announce on the environment turn what card Fido finds, the very first responder will decide what happens to that card (in play or under Fido) then I will continue on to the villain turn.

Feel free to ask questions if you have them.

As always first come first serve.

 

Heroes:

The Scholar - BlueHairedMeerkat

Nightmist - grysqrl

Unity - cmschex

Mr. Fixer (arbiter of Balance) - dpt

We'll start at noon Eastern time, may be a 4 player match.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Unfortunately, while I've been wanting to join the campaign, this isn't a good place for me to do it.  I would have been happy to be in the Omnitron / Block fight if not for its inclusion of Nightmist, who I wasn't ready to play online two weeks ago (since then I've gotten enough extra games with her to be comfortable doing it); the simple "agents are Devices and vice versa" twist is one I like.  Fido is a twist I do not like, even if not paired with other changes to a villain I still consider fairly respectable (yes he's weak compared to most other villains, but he nearly destroyed me last night, so he's not harmless; I'd put him about on a par with Baron Blade, who IMO doesn't need any help at all).

One or two small tweaks and I'm in, but something as sweeping as adding an entire character card (and not a half-incapacitated one like the Operative, but one with two full sides like a standard villain), PLUS an alternate loss condition AND upgrades to Ambuscade...it's just way too much for me to have any hope of keeping track of during PBF.  If we were all sitting at a table and you wanted to play with your homemade Fido card, I might consider it, but I'm definitely not up for this.  Have fun, y'all.

posts.cooked:
The scene was chaos, the Bus was ruined, the heroes pulling themselves and allies from the wreckage, and behind them the sounds of sirens.

"Take Ra and get to the plane, we will hold them here." John Rhodes looked at the Visionary and nodded.  He took Ra from Haka and ran into the city.

Unity ran with him, Nightmist and Slim were with them.  She looked back, Tachyon, The Wraith, Haka, The Visionary. . . more sacrifices, more people left behind.  She would make sure it wasn't in vain.

. . .

Navigating Rook City was a dangerous prospect at any time, but being hunted through the streets, that was a new experience.

The sounds of fighting were far behind them now, but getting through the city to the airstrip wasn't going to be easy.

They turned a corner, and there he was.

"Hello again, shall we dance?"

Going over it I'm changing the rules a bit, dropping the discard/Destroy from Fido from (H) to (H)-1, so for this game it will be 3.  Also setting his HP from 20 to (H)x4, so 16 for this fight.

Also Ra is starting with the Scholar since he is highest HP.

End of turn:  Ambuscade deals Ra 3 irreducible energy damage Scholar takes the damage for Ra [26], Automated Turret deals Mr. Fixer 2 projectile damage [26]
